title: AuK
idiom: two-colour screenprint, deep teal and warm red on cream
hero_prompt: Two-colour screenprint on cream paper in deep teal and warm red, flat and graphic with visible ink texture and slight misregistration, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a man in profile at the left edge, mouth open mid-phrase, and flowing from him across the whole banner a long smooth sound wave drawn as one wide teal band; one short section of the band has been cut out and a new red section fitted into the gap, joined with a neat row of tailor's stitches, the wave running on unbroken. The same voice, altered.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour teal silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: one bold, thick sound wave running left to right with a pair of open scissors cutting cleanly through its middle. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
